content:
maria: Quick Q — I'm in Vienna next week for a meetup. Cafe pastries/light lunch vs biergarten outdoor dinner? React with :coffee: for cafe, :beer: for biergarten. Any specific recs?
jon: Biergarten if it's not raining. Schweizerhaus in Prater is classic for beer and pork ribs. :+1:
shawn: Figlmüller for schnitzel if you want a proper Austrian dinner. Not a biergarten but iconic.
eva: Cafe Central for pastries + great vibes if you want to do a short work session during the day. Their apple strudel is amazing. :croissant:
lina: Naschmarkt is my vote — lots of stalls, good for groups with mixed diets (veg/vegan included). Super casual, easy to split.
ben: Budget option for a group: many Wirtshaus spots around 7th. Also Bitzinger for late-night sausage near Rathaus if anyone's hungry after drinks.
maria: Awesome — thanks! I'm leaning Naschmarkt + then find a nearby biergarten for drinks. If people want cafe vibes earlier that's fine too.
jon: Sounds like a plan. Also note for groups of 6+ in popular spots, call ahead or they fill up fast.
travels-bot: Reminder: maria: Vienna trip confirmed 2026-04-10 to 2026-04-13. Check-in: 14:00 local.
maria: Good tip — I'll try to reserve a table at Schweizerhaus in case folks want the full beer garden experience.
eva: I'm out Wed night but free Thu. If meetup is Thu evening I'm in.
lina: Thu works for me.
shawn: Thu is good.
ben: Thu works. If we end up at Naschmarkt we could pick a specific stall for a fallback meetup point (easier than wandering).
maria: Agree — I'll post a meet spot (map link) once I lock it down. Thx everyone! :heart:
jon: Vote check: I reacted with :beer:. anyone else?
eva: reacted :coffee: (but Thu drinks still welcome)
lina: reacted :beer:
shawn: reacted :beer:
ben: reacted :beer:
